title: Get benchmarks for a business category
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the benchmarks specific to a business category. After you obtain the benchmarks for a business category, you can use [/business/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-profile-data-of-a-tiktok-account/v1.3) to retrieve the profile data of your [Verified Business Account](https://ads.tiktok.com/resources/help/article/how-to-register-a-business-account) and evaluate its performance against industry standards. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/benchmark/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.
To obtain an access token, use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | business_id {Required} | string | Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.

Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041) to this field.| | business_category {Required} | string | Business category.

For enum values, see List of values for `business_category`.

Example: `ART_AND_CRAFTS`. | ``` ### List of values for `business_category` The following table lists the enum values for `business_category` and the corresponding categories. ```xtable | Value{30%} | Description {60%} | |---|---| | `ART_AND_CRAFTS` | Arts & Crafts | | `AUTOMOTIVE_AND_TRANSPORTATION` | Automative & Transportation | | `BABY` | Baby | | `BEAUTY` | Beauty | | `CLOTHING_AND_ACCESSORIES` | Clothing & Accessories | | `EDUCATION_AND_TRAINING` | Education & Training | | `ELECTRONICS` | Electronics | | `FINANCE_AND_INVESTING` | Finance & Investing | | `FOOD_AND_BEVERAGE` | Food & Beverage | | `GAMING` | Gaming | | `HEALTH_AND_WELLNESS` | Health & Wellness | | `HOME_FURNITURE_AND_APPLIANCES` | Home, Furniture & Appliances | | `MACHINERY_AND_EQUIPMENT` | Machinery & Equipment | | `MEDIA_AND_ENTERTAINMENT` | Media & Entertainment | | `PERSONAL_BLOG` | Personal Blog | | `PETS` | Pets | | `PROFESSIONAL_SERVICES` | Professional Services | | `PUBLIC_ADMINISTRATION` | Public Adminstration | | `REAL_ESTATE` | Real Estate | | `RESTAURANTS_AND_BARS` | Restaurants & Bars | | `SHOPPING_AND_RETAIL` | Shopping & Retail | | `SOFTWARE_AND_APPS` | Software & Apps | | `SPORTS_FITNESS_AND_OUTDOORS` | Sports, Fitness & Outdoors | | `TRAVEL_AND_TOURISM` | Travel & Tourism | | `OTHERS` | Others | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/benchmark/?business_id={{business_id}}&business_category=ART_AND_CRAFTS' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| business_category | string | Business category.

Example: `Art & Crafts`.  

Note that the value of this field is different from the value of the `business_category` field in the request. | #| average_likes | double | Average number of likes on owned videos across Verified Business Accounts in the business category.

Example: 22618.7106 | #| average_comments | double | Average number of comments on owned videos across Verified Business Accounts in the business category.

Example: 625.6003 | #| average_shares | double | Average number of shares on owned videos across Verified Business Accounts in the business category.

Example: 1161.3881 | #| average_video_count | double | Average number of videos across Verified Business Accounts in the business category.

Example: 138.9494 | #| average_follower_count | double | Average number of followers across Verified Business Accounts in the business category.

Example: 1592.5344 | #| average_follower_growth | double | Average increase in followers over the last 30 days across Verified Business Accounts in the business category.

Example: 24.9218 | #| average_engagement_rate | double | Average engagement rate across Verified Business Accounts in the business category.

Example: 0.0449 | #| average_video_views | double | Average video views across Verified Business Accounts in the business category.

Example: 353527.9227 | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "average_comments": 625.6003, "average_engagement_rate": 0.0449, "average_follower_count": 1592.5344, "average_follower_growth": 24.9218, "average_likes": 22618.7106, "average_shares": 1161.3881, "average_video_count": 138.9494, "average_video_views": 353527.9227, "business_category": "Art & Crafts" } } (/code) ```
